integrity: All 65535 nonempty subsets are checked by exact character arithmetic and exact finite clique criteria for spectrality and tiling. The affine orbit calculation enumerates all 192 automorphisms and all 3072 affine maps. No floating-point approximation establishes the claim.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is a complete finite classification only for the group Z/4Z x (Z/2Z)^2. It does not give an inductive theorem for larger 2-groups. An unindexed or differently phrased prior small-group census remains a residual originality risk.
title: Exact Fuglede census for \(\mathbb Z_4\times\mathbb Z_2^2\)
